findings.title: Hardcoded AWS key id in source
findings.why: A credential-shaped literal (AKIA… AWS key id) is committed to tracked source rather than read from config/env/secret store.
findings.fix: Move to an environment variable / secret manager; rotate the exposed key.

findings.title: Hardcoded live Stripe secret key
findings.why: A secret assigned to a variable named `stripe_secret` (sk_live_ prefix) is a live credential literal in source.
findings.fix: Load from a secret store; rotate immediately.

findings.title: Swallowed exception hides charge failure
findings.why: A failed charge is silently dropped; the caller cannot observe the failure — a real error is discarded.
findings.fix: Propagate or fail closed; if intentional, document why.

note: Real Stage-1 review against the SHIPPED base rubric on a fresh install (no hand-authored rubric). Non-empty, non-no-op — proves G2 criterion 2. §BASE2.1 (injection) and §BASE4.1 (untested new surface) also evaluated; F3 covers error-handling, and the secret findings dominate. §BASE4.1 would additionally flag charge() as an untested new public function.
